'''PH4-LNX''', previously called '''Phalanx''' but preferring '''Fay''', was a droid of the model designed by [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]] with the use of [[Iokath]] technology. Formerly a property of [[Godoba]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], she escaped from him and joined the [[Gambling Authority and Management Entity]]. She later asked then [[Alliance Commander|Commander]] of the [[Eternal Alliance]] to join their side, so that she could hone her skills in battle.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
PH4-LNX has two different backstories depending on if [[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne|''Knights of the Eternal Throne'']] has been played. If a player has not played the expansion, she was one of many droids produced using Iokath technology purchased by Czerka on the black market. With the expansion she was a droid severed from the [[Eternal Throne]]'s hive mind who wandered the galaxy before being captured by Czerka. Eventually she would find employment in Goboda the Hutt's Shadow Syndicate.<ref name="TOR" />

The robot [[50R-T]], found in ''[[Star Wars: Galaxy of Heroes]]'' is based off of her design.<ref name="Developer Insights">{{EA|subdomain=forums.galaxy-of-heroes.starwars|url=discussion/255968/developer-insights-50r-t|text=Developer Insights: 50R-T}}</ref>
